name: Neon Tetra
description: A dazzling nano schooler with an electric-blue stripe and red tail. Peaceful, hardy and stunning in groups of ten or more — the classic first tropical fish.

name: Ocellaris Clownfish
description: The friendly orange-and-white reef icon. Hardy, personable and reef-safe, it makes an unforgettable centerpiece — especially paired with an anemone.

name: Crowntail Betta
description: A living jewel with flowing, spiky fins in vivid reds and blues. A hardy labyrinth fish that thrives as the sole showpiece of a nano tank.

name: Fancy Guppy
description: Endlessly colorful livebearers with fan-shaped tails. Active, easy to keep and quick to breed — a splash of moving color for any community tank.

name: Silver Angelfish
description: Tall, graceful and elegant, the angelfish glides through planted tanks like living stained glass. A confident community centerpiece for taller aquariums.

name: Blue Discus
description: The 'king of the aquarium' — a disc-shaped, richly patterned cichlid for the dedicated keeper. Rewards pristine water with breathtaking color.

name: Yellow Tang
description: An electric-yellow reef grazer that lights up any saltwater display. Active and hardy, it helps keep algae in check while stealing the show.

name: Mandarin Dragonet
description: A psychedelic swirl of orange, green and blue. This peaceful, slow-moving reef gem is a favorite of experienced aquascapers with mature tanks.

name: Nano Reef Cube 30L
description: A crystal-clear rimless glass cube, perfect for a nano reef or shrimp scape on a desk or shelf. Low-iron glass for true, distortion-free viewing.

name: Aquascape Tank 120L
description: A mid-size, low-iron planted display with ultra-clear panels and silicone-clean seams. The ideal canvas for a nature-style aquascape.

name: Rimless Low-Iron Tank 240L
description: A premium, brace-free rimless aquarium in starphire glass for an open-top showpiece. Big enough for a full reef or a lush jungle scape.

name: Oak Aquarium Cabinet Stand
description: A solid oak cabinet stand with soft-close doors, hiding your sump, filters and supplies. Rated for large tanks and built to last.

name: Walnut Console Stand
description: A sleek walnut console that turns your aquarium into a statement piece of living-room furniture. Concealed cable routing and generous storage.

name: Corner Aquarium Stand
description: A space-saving corner cabinet engineered for stability, tucking a tank neatly into any room. Adjustable feet keep everything perfectly level.

name: Canister Filter Pro 1200
description: A whisper-quiet external canister moving 1200 L/h through multi-stage media for crystal-clear water. Primes with one push and runs for months.

name: Adjustable Aquarium Heater 300W
description: A shatter-resistant 300W submersible heater with precise dial control and an accurate thermostat to keep tropical fish comfortable year-round.

name: Full-Spectrum LED Light Bar
description: A programmable full-spectrum LED bar that brings out vivid fish color and drives healthy plant growth. Sunrise-to-sunset dimming built in.

name: Wavemaker Circulation Pump
description: A compact, adjustable wavemaker that creates natural flow to keep detritus suspended and corals swaying. Magnet-mounts to glass in seconds.

name: Live Java Fern Bundle
description: A hardy, low-light live plant that attaches to wood and rock — no substrate needed. Bulletproof greenery for beginners and betta tanks alike.

name: Natural Driftwood Centerpiece
description: A hand-picked, aquarium-safe driftwood piece with intricate branches — the perfect backbone for a nature-style aquascape.

name: Coral Reef Rock Set
description: Porous, aquacultured reef rock that seeds beneficial bacteria and builds a stunning reef structure for corals and fish to explore.
